# EVPN Control Plane for VXLAN

Start from the VXLAN lab and delete the static flood lines. BGP EVPN in one AS tells each leaf about the other's MAC. The VNI does not change. The underlay OSPF does not change.

Use the same figure as the VXLAN chapter. The link is still the underlay. The control plane is now BGP.

## Learning goals

By the end of this chapter you can:

- Remove a static flood list without losing host reachability
- Configure EVPN on cEOS for one VLAN
- See a type-2 route for the remote host MAC
- Tell an underlay failure from an EVPN failure

## BGP on leaf1

```text
interface Vxlan1
   vxlan source-interface Loopback0
   vxlan udp-port 4789
   vxlan vlan 10 vni 10010
router bgp 65000
   router-id 10.0.0.1
   neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65000
   neighbor 10.0.0.2 update-source Loopback0
   !
   vlan 10
      rd 10.0.0.1:10
      route-target import 65000:10
      route-target export 65000:10
      redistribute learned
   !
   address-family evpn
      neighbor 10.0.0.2 activate
```

These are iBGP speakers in the same AS. The neighbour address is the other loopback. OSPF on the underlay is what makes that address reachable, so there is no multihop knob.

leaf2 uses router-id and rd `10.0.0.2`, neighbour `10.0.0.1`, and the same route-target.

No `vxlan vlan 10 flood vtep` line. If you leave it, you will not know whether EVPN is doing the work.

## Verify

```bash
docker exec clab-vxlan-h1 ping -c 2 172.16.10.12
docker exec clab-vxlan-leaf1 Cli -c "show bgp evpn summary"
docker exec clab-vxlan-leaf1 Cli -c "show bgp evpn route-type mac-ip"
docker exec clab-vxlan-leaf1 Cli -c "show vxlan address-table"
```

### Predict

- The EVPN session is Established.
- A MAC-IP route for h2's MAC exists on leaf1 after h2 has talked.
- Shutting Ethernet2 (the underlay) drops both OSPF and the ping. The VLAN on Ethernet1 stays up. That split is the operational lesson: the host link is fine and the overlay is not.

## Drill

Change leaf2's route-target import to `65000:99`. The session stays up. The MAC route is received and not imported. The ping fails. Put the route-target back. Session state is not forwarding state.
